en: Black-and-white vintage postcard depicting a large neoclassical building and an open square with people walking. The main building has a grand central portico with columns and steps leading up from the square. Trees line the square and there are additional buildings around it. Text in French/Latin letters and Greek in the lower left names the place as Miaoulis Square in Syros. A website watermark appears at the lower right.
